title: Aphorism § 127
text:
§ 127



The medicines must be tested on both males and females, in order also
          to reveal the alterations of the health they produce in the sexual sphere.



 § 128  Fifth Edition



The most recent observations have shown that medicinal substances, when
          taken in their crude state by the experimenter for the purpose of testing their peculiar
          effects, do not exhibit nearly the full amount of the powers that lie hidden in them which
          they do when they are taken for the same object in high dilutions potentized by proper
          trituration and succussion, by which simple operations the powers which in their crude
          state lay hidden, and, as it were, dormant, are developed and roused into activity to an
          incredible extent. In this manner we now find it best to investigate the medicinal powers
          even of such substances as are deemed weak, and the plan we adopt is to give to the
          experimenter, on an empty stomach, daily from four to six very small globules of the
          thirtieth potentized dilution of such a substance, moistened with a little water, and let
          him continue this for several days.
